items.statement: Operating cash flow positive INR 7 crore for nine months ended December FY25
items.quote: For the nine months ended, there is a net positive cash flow of INR 7 crores, because of which the debt has come down compared to March levels,

items.statement: Net debt reduced by INR13 crores from INR896 crores to INR883 crores in Q3 FY25
items.quote: It's a net debt level. So , last quarter, it was INR896 crores. And this quarter, this is INR883 crores. So, we have repaid around INR13 crores.
